_about: Background candidates from ChatGPT (2026-11-20), landscape 1920x1080, judged against the stage with kit/check_backdrop.py and sprite previews. Not wired into any build.

entries.notes: calm centre, cream wall and teal band make the boy pop, equipment small and to the sides. Floor is orange: legs melt into it (distance to skin 12). Change to cool grey/blue rubber.
calmest centre (1.3% busy), grey floor (51 from skin), dark teal wall makes cyan tank and skin pop. Round emblem sits behind his belly; cabinets cropped at the edges. Good for a later chart.

busiest behind him (12.9%): three big gridded windows, one right behind his head; orange brick fights the red shorts and skin. Floor is good. Keep only with blue-grey painted brick and the windows moved to the sides.
gold gears dwarf him; beige floor nearly the same as skin (22). Fun as a story level only after the floor is made stone grey and the gold toned down.
busy shelves both sides and an arch behind him; orange floor melts his legs (9). Better as a calm break-card background.
